items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: The announcer now was playing then. I forget his name. He announces the World Series now. He was catching for them. What the heck is his name? Tim McCarver. He was with them. He was good. Tim was a good player.

ctx.x: No, Stanley was not playing then. Kenny Boyer was playing. That was their big gun, Kenny Boyer. Short and third. Short, no. He was a great player. They had a good team, a real good team. The announcer now was playing then. I forget his name. He announces the World Series now. He was catching for them. What the heck is his name? Tim McCarver. He was with them. He was good. Tim was a good player.
Well how did you like working a steady thing, a T.V. show every day?
